svg.title: The problem & our vision — Trackback
svg.text: Finance agents build on each other’s work. When an input changes later,
the team needs to know what broke, what still holds, and who must act.
FICTIONAL CASE STUDY · TIDEWALL’S SIX GYMS
A billing duplicate reaches beyond the ledger.
A $118,000 March revenue correction can change a lender certificate, a board deck, bonuses and a
tax estimate. Finding every dependency by hand is the work Trackback targets.
Record what each output actually consumed, then trace
The leverage calculation crosses a 3.00× covenant limit.
A small-looking revenue error becomes a consequential decision.
Close accountants & reporting analysts: targeted rework.
Controllers & CFOs: evidence, approval and an auditable correction trail.
Circle the downstream consequence that matters most to a finance team.
